# ISSA

> > ISSA offers comprehensive online fitness certifications, specializations, and continuing education for personal trainers, coaches, and wellness professionals.

ISSA is a leading provider of evidence-based fitness and health coaching certifications available entirely online. The platform offers foundational certifications like Personal Trainer and Fitness Coach, advanced specializations in areas like corrective exercise and strength conditioning, and emerging programs addressing modern health trends such as GLP-1 weight loss support.

## Key Topics

- Personal Trainer Certification
- Certified Nutrition Coach
- Fitness Certifications
- Specialization Programs
- Continuing Education
- Corrective Exercise Specialist
- Strength & Conditioning
- Health Coaching
- Online Certification
- Master Trainer Bundle
- Elite Trainer Bundle
- Professional Development
- Bodybuilding Specialist
- Exercise Recovery Specialist
- DNA-Based Fitness Coach

## Core Certifications

- [Personal Trainer Certification](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/personal-trainer-certification): ISSA Certified Personal Trainer (CPT) online certification program
- [Elite Trainer Certification](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/elite-trainer-certification): Elite Trainer Certification program for specialized personal training careers
- [Master Trainer Certification](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/master-trainer-certification): Master Trainer multi-discipline certification for advanced fitness professionals
- [Fitness Coach Certification](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/coach-certification): ISSA Fitness Coach certification for health and fitness career expansion

## Specialization Programs

- [Strength & Conditioning Certification](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/strength-and-conditioning-certification): Strength & Conditioning specialization for athlete performance training
- [Corrective Exercise Specialist](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/corrective-exercise-certification): Corrective Exercise Specialist certification for movement assessment training
- [Bodybuilding Specialist](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/bodybuilding-certification): Bodybuilding Specialist certification for muscle building and nutrition coaching
- [Exercise Recovery Specialist](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/exercise-recovery-specialist): Exercise Recovery Specialist certification for recovery and sleep science training
- [DNA-Based Fitness Coach](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/dna-based-fitness-coach): DNA-Based Fitness Coach certification using genetic testing for personalized training
- [Specializations Overview](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/specializations): Overview of ISSA specialization and continuing education programs

## Health & Nutrition Coaching

- [Nutrition Coach Certification](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/nutritionist): Certified Nutrition Coach certification for evidence-based nutrition coaching
- [Certified Health Coach](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/certified-health-coach): NBHWC Certified Health Coach program for wellness and lifestyle coaching
- [Weight Management Specialist](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/weight-management-specialist): Weight Management Specialist certification for body transformation coaching
- [Obesity & Diabetes Management Course](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/obesity-and-diabetes-management-course): Obesity & Diabetes Management certification for specialized health coaching
- [GLP-1 Weight Loss Support Training](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/glp-1-weight-loss): GLP-1 Weight Loss Support Training for clients on Ozempic and Wegovy

## Professional Development

- [Business of Personal Training](https://www.issaonline.com/certification/business-of-personal-training): Business specialization course for personal trainer career development
- [Continuing Education Courses](https://www.issaonline.com/continuing-education): ISSA continuing education courses for professional development
